basic_details.job_title: MPPGCL ITI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 29 Electrician, Fitter and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Madhya Pradesh Power Generating Company Limited (MPPGCL), Anuppur, has invited applications for 29 posts in 6 roles under Advt No. 001-01/TRAINING/451. The posts include Fitter, Turner, Welder, Motor Mechanic and 2 more. Applications are accepted online until 20 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will MPPGCL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications based on ITI aggregate marks (semester average percentage) Document verification Merit list based on percentage of total marks obtained in ITI

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificate of Medical Fitness Caste certificate if applicable Divyang certificate if applicable Aadhaar card Bank details

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPPGCL Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Register on apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Go to Register As Candidate and fill personal, contact and qualification details. Upload photo, date of birth proof and signature. Search Establishment as Amarkantak Thermal Power Station, Chachai, District Anuppur and apply according to qualifications. Apply on or before 20 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Only permanent residents of MP are eligible Selected candidates must have accident insurance policy of at least 1 lakh rupees

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MPPGCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MPPGCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 29 vacancies: 8 Fitter, 3 Turner, 3 Welder, 3 Motor Mechanic, 10 Electrician, 2 COPA.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MPPGCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years, maximum 25 years for General category (as on 20 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer 5 years, Divyang 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 9600 for Fitter, 9600 for Turner, 9600 for Welder, 9600 for Motor Mechanic, 9600 for Electrician.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ITI pass in relevant trade. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must be permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh. Preference given to residents of Anuppur, Shahdol, Umaria, Katni, Jabalpur districts.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates previously registered or undergone apprenticeship in any establishment or worked for more than one year.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications based on ITI aggregate marks (semester average percentage). Document verification. Merit list based on percentage of total marks obtained in ITI.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Training duration is one year. No guarantee of employment after completion of apprenticeship.
